newsitem.title: UK: INSTANT VIEW - UK March retail price data.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - UK March retail price data.

text.p: Following is a list of analysts' reactions to UK March retail price inflation data published at 0830 GMT.
Headline RPI rose 0.3 percent on the month and 2.6 percent year-on-year. RPIX inflation was 2.7 percent year-on-year.

"The government must be pretty pleased with today's numbers. They will use today's numbers, together with a strong employment report yesterday, to underline the generally strong performance we're seeing in the UK economy."
"Food is a volatile commodity. We should see some impact of the so-called drought feeding through into food prices in the coming months."

"The headline figure and RPIX are slightly below expectations. In terms of monetary policy, it shows a tightening of labour markets. We predict a modest increase in interest rates. The 2.5 percent inflation target is in sight over the next two months"

"The government really couldn't help for a much better economic backdrop. They will say there's a very good chance underlying inflation will fall to 2.5 percent in the coming months. But I think we will see inflation trough in the next couple of months."
